data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English words 'god' and 'wealh' meaning 'foreigner' or 'stranger'. The name Bodwell translates to 'House of God' for those who are considered outsiders or foreigners in their religious community. The name Bodwell carries the meaning “House of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bodwell usually hope their child will grow to embody house of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
